best_moment.what: The maiden speech, where I said the one thing I truly believe, and then got a note from a Minister I'd never met saying 'That needed saying.' It was the one point where the honesty felt like it was building to something.

worst_moment.what: Walking every block for nine nights, then losing at 48.2% with a card telling me it was never going to be about me anyway. All that effort and the result felt decided before I tapped.

skip_year.why: The tea-as-vetting stretch was slow and full of terms I didn't know. I had to guess what was happening until the disappointed man showed up.

answer.held_back_by: Probably the party, not me. The card says they rated me Senior Minister of State, but I lost a seat on 48.2% after being honest and never saying 'team effort'. I suspect honesty raised my integrity but cost me standing, and the game never made clear which mattered at the ballot.
answer.ending_fair_why: The loss felt imposed. I walked every block as a choice and the card basically said it didn't matter, so my choice was pointless. Also the 'it was never going to be about you' line felt like the game telling me my agency was fake. The declassified file was great, though.
answer.chase_next: Take the 'Say it was a team effort' choice at 31 and see how far up the party ladder I get. I want to know whether lying actually gets you to Senior Minister of State, and whether integrity 97 is a ceiling in disguise.
answer.play_again_why: I want to see the other side of that Y31 fork. The declassified card made me curious what a less honest run looks like, and it is only a short life.

tone_breaks.line: it was never going to be about you anyway
tone_breaks.note: Undercuts the nine nights I chose to walk. It felt like the game dismissing my choice rather than the system being unfair, which is a bit harsh to the player.

tone_breaks.line: THE YEAR IT CHANGED: It never did. It could have: at 31, "Say it was a team effort."
tone_breaks.note: Slightly confusing. The age shown is 31 but my notes track years as 'Y' numbers, and I was in my early 30s around Y6-Y9. I'm not sure what I was meant to have been asked at that point.

answer.title_fit_why: The game is about whether you get kept and promoted for staying straight, not about the pay. The Minister Salary part barely mattered to me; I only noticed the pay lines in passing.
